articles.title: Lucknow Outrage: Milkman Spits Into Milk Before Delivery, Arrested After CCTV Exposes Act
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lucknow — A shocking incident of food contamination has come to light in Vinay Khand, Gomti Nagar, where a milkman was caught on CCTV spitting into a milk container moments before delivering it to a household.

body.html:
Lucknow — A shocking incident of food contamination has come to light in Vinay Khand, Gomti Nagar, where a milkman was caught on CCTV spitting into a milk container moments before delivering it to a household. The accused, identified as Mohammad Sharif alias Pappu, has been arrested by police following public outrage and protests.

The incident occurred in early July when resident Luv Shukla checked his home’s CCTV footage and discovered the milkman opening the can, looking around, spitting inside, and then closing it before ringing the doorbell.

The video quickly went viral, sparking widespread anger, particularly because the milk was reportedly used for religious rituals during the Kanwar Yatra.

Following a complaint lodged at Gomti Nagar police station, police registered an FIR and arrested Mohammad Sharif. Officials confirmed he had been delivering milk in the area for years, allegedly under a false identity to conceal his real name.

Members of the Akhil Bharat Hindu Mahasabha, led by spokesperson Shishir Chaturvedi, staged protests, demanding stringent action and invoking the National Security Act against the accused, citing the religious and public health implications of his act.

Police have confirmed the investigation is ongoing.

articles.title: Shocking Fake Sanitary Pad Scandal: Rahul Gandhi Dragged into Dirty Conspiracy!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: New Delhi: Congress spokesperson Supriya Shrinate has dismissed viral images showing Rahul Gandhi’s photo on sanitary pads as “completely fake” and announced legal action against those spreading the hoax.

body.html:
New Delhi: Congress spokesperson Supriya Shrinate has dismissed viral images showing Rahul Gandhi’s photo on sanitary pads as “completely fake” and announced legal action against those spreading the hoax.

In a statement on Friday, Shrinate alleged these doctored images are part of a "dirty conspiracy" orchestrated by the BJP's IT cell. She said:

“BJP और उनके लोग एक फेक वीडियो चला रहे हैं… यह पूरी तरह से फेक है – इसके खिलाफ कानूनी कार्रवाई की जा रही है। BJP नफरत में इतना गिर गई… शर्मनाक।”

Bihar Congress also echoed the party’s position, branding the allegation false and highlighting that actual sanitary pad packets under the “Mai‑Behin Maan Yojana” do not feature Gandhi’s photo.

Congress has accused the BJP of “stooping so low” that even initiatives aimed at women have been targeted with slander.

articles.title: Patna on Ganga Path: New Car Plunges Into River After Driver Presses Accelerator Instead of Brake
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Patna — A major tragedy was averted on Friday evening in the Digha police station area of Patna, when a car carrying a young couple plunged into the Ganga river but they were rescued in time. The incident took place around 6:30 pm near Minar Ghat on Ganga Path.

body.html:
Patna — A major tragedy was averted on Friday evening in the Digha police station area of Patna, when a car carrying a young couple plunged into the Ganga river but they were rescued in time.

The incident took place around 6:30 pm near Minar Ghat on Ganga Path. According to police, Aditya Prakash, a resident of Pataliputra, was out for a drive with his wife in a new Honda City car. While manoeuvring the vehicle, he mistakenly pressed the accelerator instead of the brake, causing the car to lose balance and fall into the river.

Witnesses said the car floated briefly as its windows were shut, before it started sinking about 20–30 metres from the ghat, where the current was strong and the depth was around 40–50 feet.

Fortunately, some sailors present nearby rushed to help. After about 45 minutes of effort, they managed to break open the glass and rescue Aditya and his wife. Both were unharmed but visibly shaken.

The dramatic incident, captured on video, is now going viral on social media.

articles.title: Jabalpur’s ‘Vikas’ Sinks: Auto Overturns in Water-Filled Pothole After First Rain
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jabalpur, MP — The first rain exposed the tall claims of development in Jabalpur as a water-filled pothole in Aadhartal area led to a shocking accident.

body.html:
Jabalpur, MP — The first rain exposed the tall claims of development in Jabalpur as a water-filled pothole in Aadhartal area led to a shocking accident. On 26 June, an auto carrying two women, two school children, and the driver overturned after falling into a hidden pit on a waterlogged road.

Locals rushed to rescue the passengers safely. The driver reportedly failed to spot the pothole due to rainwater. CCTV footage of the incident has since gone viral, sparking questions over the Municipal Corporation’s negligence.

Residents allege repeated complaints about the damaged drain and pothole were ignored.

articles.title: Massive Fire Guts Rishikesh Wedding Point, Vehicles and Houses Damaged
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Rishikesh — A massive fire broke out at a wedding point in Ganganagar area around 4 AM on Friday due to a short circuit. Six people were sleeping inside when the blaze erupted, fuelled by cloth tents and foam chairs, and spread rapidly.

body.html:
Rishikesh — A massive fire broke out at a wedding point in Ganganagar area around 4 AM on Friday due to a short circuit. Six people were sleeping inside when the blaze erupted, fuelled by cloth tents and foam chairs, and spread rapidly.

Four vehicles parked nearby were completely burnt, and flames even reached adjacent houses, forcing residents to remove gas cylinders and belongings.

Despite the efforts of eight fire engines, the fire could not be brought under control. Mayor Shambhu Paswan, spotting the flames during his morning walk, rushed to the scene to assess the situation.
